episode_row: 3am cron could publish the R2 manifest over a failed rebuild

commits.subject: fix(cron): gate the 3am R2 sync on a successful build
commits.body:
The nightly `pull && build && preview ; sync-to-r2` used `;` before sync, so
sync-to-r2 ran even if pull/build failed. With the is_resumed_portion SCHEMA_VERSION
bump, a failed 2026 rebuild could then publish a new-schema R2 manifest over stale
(old-schema) parquets -- a silent manifest/physical-schema mismatch. Group preview +
sync after `&& build` so neither runs unless pull+build succeed, keeping the `;`
between them so a preview error doesn't block the R2 backup and a sync failure (R2
outage) doesn't block preview. Surfaced by the post-deploy Codex review.
